prompt:
Style references only: the attached images set the painting style, the colours and the mood. Do not copy their content. Paint it as a concept artist's painted sketch sheet for a cozy, bright strategy game: loose hand-painted brushwork with visible strokes, soft painted light from a warm sunny afternoon coming from the front right, cheerful bright colours, a warm light cream paper background with a soft painted shadow under each object. It is a painting, not a 3D render, not low poly, not a game screenshot. Cozy and friendly like a storybook toy, never grim. No people, no text, no labels, no numbers, no letters, no watermark.

The sheet shows three small piles of stones for a toy fortress game, side by side in one row, each lying on its own square grass tile one metre wide, seen in a three-quarter view from slightly above. The tiles lie loose on the cream paper like game pieces, their edges drawn as a slightly darker green line, so the size of each pile reads against its tile. Every pile has the same shape: two or three rounded soft stones leaning together, about half a tile wide and a quarter of a tile tall, sitting directly on the grass. The three piles differ only in their stone colours: Left: warm cream stones, a soft cream highlight on top. Middle: soft warm grey stones, a pale grey highlight on top. Right: sandy golden stones, a light sand highlight on top. In front of the middle object, on its own tile, stands a small dark iron cannon on a low square plate that fills its tile: it is the size reference of the game. The stone pile must read as much smaller than the cannon.
label: round 23 stones palette board
